name: Media Contextual Crop Focal Point Adapter
description: Provides a plugin for using focal_point in contextual crop
project_description:
This module provide an adapter between Media Contextual Crop API and Focal Point Crop Plugin 

 This module is just a plugin use by Media Contextual Crop implementation please check :

 - Media Contextual Cropping Embed 

- Media Contextual Cropping Field Formatter 

 Requirements 
 - Media Contextual Crop API 

- Focal Point Crop Plugin 

 Branchs 
 1.1.x 
 The 1.1.x branch are compatible with 1.2.x branch of main module in order to make it compatible with the core responsive_image formatter

 2.0.x 
 - Fully compatible with Media_contextual_crop 2.0.x release

- Add context in embed media, in order to limit ghost crop & images

- Remove all Drupal 9 compatibilities
